info.name: Fleet Management System
info.description:
Requests for the Fleet Management System API Gateway.

1. Import this collection.
2. Check the collection variables `baseUrl` and `apiKey`.
3. The API key is sent automatically (collection-level auth: header `x-api-key`), except where a request overrides it.

Admin login: set `adminEmail` / `adminPassword` (defaults match `.env.example`; override them in a Postman environment for your own admin).

item.name: Gateway
item.description: Health, routing, API key verification and rate limiting.

request.description: No API key needed.
Gateway pings all 5 services. 503 if any is down.
No x-api-key header → 401 MISSING_API_KEY.
Wrong x-api-key → 401 INVALID_API_KEY.
Valid API key (collection auth). Gateway forwards to user-service's /health; the `service` field proves routing.
Valid API key (collection auth). Gateway forwards to vehicle-service's /health; the `service` field proves routing.
Valid API key (collection auth). Gateway forwards to telemetry-service's /health; the `service` field proves routing.
Valid API key (collection auth). Gateway forwards to maps-service's /health; the `service` field proves routing.
Valid API key (collection auth). Gateway forwards to notification-service's /health; the `service` field proves routing.
Unknown /api prefix → 404 NOT_FOUND.

item.name: Users

item.name: Notifications
item.description: SMS notifications on vehicle status change (flow 4). Self-contained: the folder script logs in and creates demo users + a demo vehicle on first use, so just run the numbered requests in order (select the "Fleet Local" environment).

request.description: Picks a status different from the current one, so the change always happens and SMS are sent. The response shows how many SMS were sent / failed.

exec: // Read the current status and choose a different one
pm.test('Only failed records with an error', () => records.forEach((n) => { pm.expect(n.status).to.eql('failed'); pm.expect(n.error).to.be.a('string'); }));
